card.name: Linking words before amounts or timeframes
card.fires_on: Short linking words (to, within, in) that come right before a number, dose or time span. Seen after verbs like reduce, resolve, recover or compared.

modes.label: Reduce to a dose
modes.description: The word "to" after a dose-reduction verb, just before the new dose or frequency.
modes.example: the dose should be reduced<< to>> 4 mg once daily taken with a

modes.label: Resolves within a time
modes.description: "within" or "in" after resolve or recover verbs, before a time span.
modes.example: They generally resolve<< within>> a few hours after taking the dose,

modes.label: Compared to a rate
modes.example: compared<< to>> a rate of about 2.6

card.writes: It seems to make the next word a number or amount, and to lower the word "only".
card.plain: It fires on small words like "to" and "within" that come just before a dose or a time span.
